budget_items.topic: Bond anticipation note for feasibility study
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Treasurer-Collector asked approval to borrow a short-term bond anticipation note for the feasibility study; five bids were received and Century Bank had the lowest rate; note due May 15, 2014.
budget_items.quote: the note will be due on may 15, 2014 and the total interest paid will be $452.22

budget_items.topic: School project cost and ballot question
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The ballot question omits project cost; a separate mailing to residents will present all school building project costs.
budget_items.quote: there will be a separate mailing to residents with all costs of the school building project done by the political: action

budget_items.topic: MSBA reimbursement rate and total project budget
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The MSBA reimbursement rate for the project is 59.11%, including 1.5% from the 40R development at Tri-Town; total project budget is $72,975,321 with a maximum total facilities grant of $36, 190,870.
budget_items.quote: total project budget for the school project which is $72,975,321. with a maximum total facilities grant of $36, 190,870.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Sewer Commission submitted about $53,000 of delinquent sewer bills to the Treasurer/Collector to be added to tax bills.
budget_items.quote: approximately $53,000 worth of delinquent sewer bills to be added to the tax bills

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Two warrants dated 12/10/2013 were listed for approval with two printed amounts.
